title: Remaining issues #91 — bg removal / anonymize faces / sticker export (v0.9.24)
body:
Confirmed bugs after v0.9.23 release:
- Background removal: 1-frame zoom mask pasted over entire video
- Anonymize faces: B/W applied to whole clip instead of just blurred face regions
- Sticker overlay: export fails (Filter not found / 0xb3b6b908 exit)
- Fix requires: proper mask generation + blend/overlay filtergraph + seek_for video
Status: AI effect pipeline needs mask generation + correct filter syntax before 0.9.24.
